name: Ooty
description: Queen of Hill Stations nestled in the Nilgiri hills with tea estates, cool misty weather, and botanical gardens.

name: Goa
description: Tropical paradise renowned for sun-kissed beaches, vibrant nightlife, Portuguese colonial architecture, and fresh seafood.

name: Manali
description: High-altitude Himalayan resort town known for snow peaks, adventure sports, lush valleys, and scenic trekking trails.

name: Jaipur
description: The Pink City famous for majestic forts, royal palaces, vibrant bazaars, rich Rajasthani heritage, and intricate architecture.

name: Munnar
description: Serene hill town in the Western Ghats surrounded by rolling tea plantations, misty mountains, and exotic flora.

name: Varanasi
description: Spiritual capital of India situated on the banks of the sacred Ganges, famous for ancient ghats, evening aarti, and silk weaving.

name: Udaipur
description: City of Lakes featuring romantic palaces, serene lake boat rides, grand Rajput courtyards, and scenic sunsets.

name: Agra
description: Home to the world-renowned Taj Mahal, magnificent Mughal fortresses, UNESCO monuments, and rich artisan crafts.
